blurb: Guests sail aboard the Kajama, a traditional tall ship, enjoying views of Toronto Harbour and Lake Ontario. The experience includes opportunities to assist in hoisting sails and learn about sailing. The ship offers day and evening cruises, private charters, corporate events, weddings, and educational outings.
